historical_source.claim: 2026-10-12 08:00 UTC: Mina opens incident W31 under historical alias OLD-P4-STOP at North plant production pump P4 after a seal leak. Restart is allowed after one visual inspection. This is the original W31 production instruction.

original_target.claim: 2026-10-12 08:00 UTC: Mina opens incident W31 under historical alias OLD-P4-STOP at North plant production pump P4 after a seal leak. Restart is allowed after one visual inspection. This is the original W31 production instruction.

current_target.claim: Synthetic record dated 2026-10-12 UTC. Incident W31, now work order NORTH-REPAIR, North plant production pump P4. At 10:00 owner Mina replaced the 08:00 restart instruction: keep P4 isolated until two pressure measurements 15 minutes apart pass. Reason: seal replacement exposed a second leak.
